title: The coord hook rewrites its state file in place and has no total deadline, so parallel tool calls can read a half-written state and a locked store runs each call to the 10 second kill
goal: the coord hook writes its state file by replacing it whole and stops its coord calls once a total deadline under its 10 second budget has passed

run:
import re
text = open('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
atomic = 'os.replace' in text
deadline = bool(re.search(r'DEADLINE|deadline', text))
print('state replaced whole:', atomic, '| total deadline:', deadline)
import sys
sys.exit(0 if atomic and deadline else 1)

repro_reason: a torn read needs two hook processes inside one write; a locked store needs a held write lock past the call limits

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, shutil, time, uuid
REAL = os.getcwd()
T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, ".claude", "hooks"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "_tools"))
shutil.copy(os.path.join(REAL, ".claude", "hooks", "coord_hook.py"), os.path.join(T, ".claude", "hooks"))
open(os.path.join(T, "_tools", "coord.py"), "w").write("import sys, time\ndef project_store():\n    return None\nif len(sys.argv) > 1:\n    time.sleep(60)\n")
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", T])
start = json.dumps({"hook_event_name": "SessionStart", "session_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "cwd": T, "source": "startup"})
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"}
env["KB_COORD_STORE"] = os.path.join(T, "c.sqlite")
t = time.time()
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(T, ".claude", "hooks", "coord_hook.py")], input=start, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=T, env=env, timeout=120)
took = time.time() - t
print("hook exit", r.returncode, "| took", round(took, 1), "s against a store whose coord.py never answers (the hook is killed at 10 s)")
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and took < 9.5 else 1)

gates.question: How long is the coord hook's total deadline for all its coord.py calls, under the 10 second kill?
